name: zclass_cls_di_build_pick_candidate_for_segment_vs_polygon
description: zClass_cls_di::BuildPickCandidateForSegmentVsPolygon intersects a segment against an untextured polygon face and fills the hit position and surface normal when the projected hit is inside the face.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this polygon intersection helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass cls_di source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja HLIL expands the x87 status-word comparisons and dominant-axis edge-test switch into verbose temporaries, so functional evidence is tied to the inspected assembly and native smoke.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4857f0 validates the zMath::Vec3TriangleNormal dependency, backface-cull test, segment-plane side checks, hit interpolation, surface-normal and hit-position writes, dominant-axis projected edge-test switch, EAX hit return, and stdcall-style stack cleanup of the four stack arguments.

The native cls_di smoke verifies direct hit, outside-polygon miss, backface culling behavior, degenerate/parallel rejection, and reverse-direction hit behavior for BuildPickCandidateForSegmentVsPolygon.
